integrity: Unrestricted formula has a full combinatorial proof and distinct finite verifier; historical originality is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Standard labeled Möbius ladder only (\(n\ge3\)); no orbit enumeration. An earlier equivalent graded enumeration in McSorley 1998 remains a priority risk because full text was inaccessible. Finite experiments are corroborative, not proofs.
title: Odd-cardinality rigidity and exact independent-domination polynomial of Möbius ladders
